scope: all 5183 documents; all 300 query IDs in BEIR test qrels; known benchmark, not a new independent holdout
input: title + space + abstract; no query labels enter scoring

bm25.tokenizer: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs, no stemming or stopword removal

dense.search: exact dot product of normalized float32 vectors

rerank_tail: rerank hybrid top50, append unchanged ranks 51-100
timing: CPU 4 torch threads, batch32; warm models, one measured pass per query; components added for hybrid and rerank totals; excludes loading/download, tokenization included
label_policy: freeze all rankings and timings before reading relevance scores; score once; later changes are benchmark development, never new independent test
